description: Whether a phone number (or email) can receive iMessage, through Sendblue's own lookup: iMessage, SMS only, or undetermined (Sendblue's answer when it cannot tell, which is not the same as SMS). Up to 20 at a time; Sendblue allows 30 lookups an hour and 100 a day per line by default. Sendblue only. Free. Needs the brand's own Sendblue or LoopMessage account connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: check_imessage_support
title: Check a number for iMessage
